links.title: Mastering Bitcoin, 3rd edition - Chapter 7: Authorization and Authentication (the book's source, CC BY-SA 4.0)
links.why: The chapter itself, free to read: every quotation in this page is re-read from the commit the textbook ontology pins.

links.title: BIP 16: Pay to Script Hash (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the pay to script hash output, the redeem script and the rules of its validation that this page runs.

links.title: BIP 65: OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the opcode that makes an output wait for an absolute height or time.

links.title: BIP 66: Strict DER signatures (status: Deployed)
links.why: The rule whose activation on 4 July 2015 produced the six-block fork of the second story.

links.title: BIP 68: Relative lock-time using consensus-enforced sequence numbers (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the encoding of a relative timelock in the sequence field.

links.title: BIP 112: CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the opcode that makes an output wait for a relative age.

links.title: BIP 141: Segregated Witness (Consensus layer) (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the witness program, the witness structure and version 0 spending rules.

links.title: BIP 143: Transaction Signature Verification for Version 0 Witness Program (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the signature hash that commits to the amount of the spent output.

links.title: BIP 147: Dealing with dummy stack element malleability (status: Deployed)
links.why: Makes the extra element of OP_CHECKMULTISIG an empty byte array.

links.title: BIP 173: Base32 address format for native v0-16 witness outputs (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the bech32 address that this page encodes in the browser.

links.title: BIP 340: Schnorr Signatures for secp256k1 (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the 64-byte signature that taproot key path spends and tapscript use.

links.title: BIP 341: Taproot: SegWit version 1 spending rules (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines the output key, the key path, the script path and the control block this page computes.

links.title: BIP 342: Validation of Taproot Scripts (status: Deployed)
links.why: Defines tapscript: OP_CHECKSIGADD, the disabled multisignature opcodes, MINIMALIF and the OP_SUCCESS opcodes.

links.title: BIP 327: MuSig2 for BIP340-compatible Multi-Signatures (status: Deployed)
links.why: The standard of the scriptless n-of-n multisignature that the chapter describes as future work.

links.title: BIP 379: Miniscript (status: Draft)
links.why: Defines the fragments and type system that the chapter's Miniscript section introduces.

links.title: Bitcoin Core: src/script/interpreter.cpp (EvalScript and VerifyScript)
links.why: The code whose behaviour the interpreter of this chapter reproduces and is tested against.

links.title: Bitcoin Core: src/test/data/script_tests.json (the script test vectors)
links.why: The 1,237 script tests that the chapter's interpreter accepts, one by one.

links.title: Bitcoin Core: src/policy/policy.cpp (standard scripts and the data carrier rule)
links.why: The relay policy for multisignatures, data outputs and script hashes that differs from consensus.

links.title: Script - Bitcoin Wiki
links.why: The community reference for every opcode, including the disabled ones.

links.title: Transactions - Bitcoin (developer guide)
links.why: The developer guide's account of signature hash types, P2PKH, P2SH and multisignatures.

links.title: Taproot | Bitcoin Optech
links.why: A topic page with the news, the specifications and the tools for taproot.

links.title: Tapscript | Bitcoin Optech
links.why: A topic page on the script language of the leaves of a taproot tree.

links.title: Miniscript | Bitcoin Optech
links.why: A topic page on writing scripts that a program can analyse.

links.title: MuSig | Bitcoin Optech
links.why: A topic page on the scriptless multisignature scheme.

links.title: Segregated witness | Bitcoin Optech
links.why: A topic page on the upgrade that moved authorization data into the witness.

links.title: The inscription spend of block 775,072 on mempool.space: the one script path spend of the page's census
links.why: A real taproot script path spend: a witness of 3 items, a script of 720 bytes and a control block of 33 bytes.

links.title: Alice's transaction 46620030... on mempool.space: a key path spend
links.why: A real taproot key path spend with one 65-byte witness item.

links.title: Block 709,632 on mempool.space: the block at which taproot rules took effect
links.why: The activation block of the third story.

links.title: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System (the whitepaper)
links.why: The original description, in which an output is a public key and a signature is the only authorization.

links.title: Bitcoin 0.3.0 source: script.cpp, the first script engine
links.why: The engine in which OP_RETURN jumped to the end of the joined script, the bug of the first story.

links.title: Some Miners Generating Invalid Blocks (Bitcoin.org network alert, 4 July 2015)
links.why: The contemporary record of the strict-DER fork of the second story.

links.title: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures - Bitcoin Wiki
links.why: The list that records CVE-2010-5141, the OP_RETURN bug.

links.title: Taproot - Bitcoin Wiki
links.why: The community's summary of the taproot soft fork and its parts.

links.title: Andreas Antonopoulos - Introduction to Bitcoin (Wikimedia Commons, Creative Commons licence on the file page)
links.why: A talk by the book's first author, hosted on Wikimedia Commons.

_note: Every link was fetched over HTTPS on 2026-10-08 from this session and answered 200 (a ranged request for the large raw files answered 206, partial content); the title recorded for a BIP is the Title line of its own preamble and its status is quoted from its preamble too, because a student needs to know whether what they are reading is deployed, draft or closed. GitHub's HTML pages answer 403 to this session's proxy, so the book chapter, the proposals and the Bitcoin Core files are linked through raw.githubusercontent.com, which serves the same files. learnmeabitcoin.com and bitcoin.stackexchange.com answered 403 to this session and are not listed. YouTube answers this session with a redirect to a consent page, so no YouTube video is listed; the one video is hosted on Wikimedia Commons, whose licence is on the file page, and its file page, read in this session, says the video was released under the Creative Commons licence option on YouTube (uploaded 24 September 2016).
